text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san, happy birthday♪ The two of us 
prepared a birthday cake for you~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks!! I'd really love to have some, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My hands are full right now! Could you 
wait until I finish sorting out this 
mountain of presents?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You truly are popular with everyone...! 
Would you like me to lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"No worries. I'm the one they're 
celebrating. I'll see it through 
responsibly!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely go pick up the cake too, 
so just wait for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, no, please let me help after all. 
Since we're making them, I want you to 
enjoy them fresh out of the oven♪ Right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is purely our own selfishness... 
So it won't go against your creed of 
"taking care of things yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you never miss a beat, do you! 
...All right, give me a hand then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Turning down a "present" filled with the 
feelings of two people wouldn't be very 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I knew you'd say that, Heart-san♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hop to it! The freshly baked cake 
is waiting for you!
